title: repro_briefs.csv holds one research brief per benchmark area: scope, official sources to prefer and depth
goal: kb/public/_retrieval/repro_briefs.csv holds one row per area for 21 areas (podman, puppet, chef, almalinux, kali, gentoo, zsh, bash, fish, cmd, robocopy, ssh-windows-estate, jea, typescript, age, sops, rust, python, cpython, uv and pip, where ssh-windows-estate means OpenSSH on Windows with its key management and its GPO and Intune deployment); each row has the columns area, scope, sources (the official documentation hosts and pages to prefer), depth (what a complete answer covers), coverage (present, partial or absent) and leave_out (what the kb already holds, with its articles), the coverage measured with rag.py pack and audit at the commit the file lands on; it names no benchmark question; bench_repro.brief_problems finds no problem in it.

run:
import importlib.util,subprocess,sys
sys.path.insert(0,'_tools')
if importlib.util.find_spec('bench_repro') is None: print('no bench_repro module yet'); sys.exit(1)
import bench_repro as b
want=sorted(['podman', 'puppet', 'chef', 'almalinux', 'kali', 'gentoo', 'zsh', 'bash', 'fish', 'cmd', 'robocopy', 'ssh-windows-estate', 'jea', 'typescript', 'age', 'sops', 'rust', 'python', 'cpython', 'uv', 'pip'])
r=b.load_briefs(); p=b.brief_problems(r); got=sorted(x['area'] for x in r)
print(p, [a for a in want if a not in got], [a for a in got if a not in want]); sys.exit(0 if not p and got==want else 1)

import csv,os,re,sys
f='kb/public/_retrieval/repro_briefs.csv'
if not os.path.exists(f): print('no',f); sys.exit(1)
rows=list(csv.DictReader(open(f,encoding='utf-8')))
bad=[(r.get('area'),k) for r in rows for k,v in r.items() if k and v and re.search(r'\w\?(\s|$)',re.sub(r'https?://\S+','',v))]
cols=[k for k in (rows[0].keys() if rows else []) if k and 'question' in k.lower()]
print(len(rows),bad[:5],cols); sys.exit(0 if rows and not bad and not cols else 1)
